title: BotTurnStartedPayload
description: bot.turn.started v1 (OpenVibe.Bot server/domain/index.js currentTurn). A queue robot's next person in line got their turn. It never names the person (no member ever learns the active driver's subject): guest says whether a signed-out viewer holds it. Envelope: subject { type: robot, id: <robot id> }, visibility internal, priority normal, actor service:bot.

ends_at.description: When the turn ends unless it pauses (an owner's takeover, or the robot not ready).

guest.description: A signed-out viewer holds the turn (the owner let guests take turns).

waiting.description: How many people are still in line.
